servinfo.title: Radiator Cooling Fan Assembly Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Radiator Cooling Fan Assembly On-Vehicle Inspection:K14D

s1.ptxt: Remove radiator with radiator cooling fan assembly.
Release claws (1), and then remove radiator cooling fan assembly (2) from radiator.
Remove intercooler inlet pipe (3) and Intercooler outlet pipe (4) from radiator cooling fan assembly, if necessary.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Install intercooler outlet pipe and intercooler outlet pipe, if removed.
